pretexts: buyer claims to be located out of town and offers to buy item unseen
payment is pending but requires tracking number to release funds
buyer cannot send payment due to problem with seller's PayPal or bank account
buyer sends overpayment and asks seller to wire excess funds back
fake etransfer notification asking seller to accept transfer as payment
QR code sent claiming seller must scan to receive payment
QR code sent claiming to be payment but is actually a payment request
classified ads for lower priced or free animals
rental property available in ideal locations at below average prices
counterfeit merchandise sold at big discounts on fake manufacturer websites
interac_context: Fraudsters send fake etransfer email or text messages asking sellers to accept a transfer as payment to steal banking credentials and access bank accounts.
emerging_tactics: spoofed email addresses and text message numbers

kill_chain_signals.contact: Fraudsters contact sellers who posted online ads on social media or classified sites
kill_chain_signals.pretext: Buyer claims to be out of town, offers to buy unseen, or sends fake payment notification requiring action
kill_chain_signals.payment: Victim instructed to send reimbursement via money service business, wire excess funds, or provide banking credentials via QR code or fake etransfer link
kill_chain_signals.movement: Victim ships item and provides tracking number, or sends reimbursement through Western Union or MoneyGram
kill_chain_signals.cashout: Fraudsters gain access to victim's bank account to steal money, or receive wire transfer of excess funds

red_flags: if the asking price of a product is too good to be true, it is
no customer phone number or email listed on the website
payment notification requires action like providing tracking number to release funds
buyer asks you to reimburse them for fees using money service business
key_quote: The email looks official, but the fraudsters want to steal your banking credentials to access your bank accounts and steal your money!
